description: This file defines the Aws\S3\S3Client class, a PHP SDK client for interacting with Amazon S3. It includes methods for bucket and object operations, middleware configurations, endpoint handling, and documentation enhancements specific to S3 features and behaviors.

classes.name: S3Client
classes.description: A PHP SDK client class for Amazon S3 providing methods for bucket and object management, with middleware and endpoint handling tailored for S3 features.

methods.name: createPresignedRequest
methods.description: Creates a presigned URL request for S3 objects with specified expiration.

methods.name: getObjectUrl
methods.description: Generates a non-signed URL for an S3 object based on bucket and key.

methods.name: encodeKey
methods.description: Encodes a key for URL safety, preserving '/' characters.

methods.name: isBucketDnsCompatible
methods.description: Checks if a bucket name is DNS compatible for virtual-hosted style URLs.

methods.name: _apply_use_arn_region
methods.description: Applies configuration for using ARN region overrides.

methods.name: getLocationConstraintMiddleware
methods.description: Provides middleware to set location constraints for bucket creation.

methods.name: getSaveAsParameter
methods.description: Provides middleware supporting the SaveAs parameter for GetObject.

methods.name: getHeadObjectMiddleware
methods.description: Provides middleware to disable content decoding on HeadObject commands.

methods.name: getEncodingTypeMiddleware
methods.description: Provides middleware to auto-set encoding type on ListObjects commands.

methods.name: getEmptyPathWithQuery
methods.description: Middleware to handle empty paths with query strings in requests.

methods.name: getDisableExpressSessionAuthMiddleware
methods.description: Provides middleware to disable express session auth if opted out.

methods.name: getSigningName
methods.description: Determines signing service name, especially for s3-object-lambda.

methods.name: _default_disable_express_session_auth
methods.description: Default provider for disabling express session auth.

methods.name: _default_s3_express_identity_provider
methods.description: Default provider for creating S3 express identities.

methods.name: processModel
methods.description: Modifies API definition for endpoint handling and deprecations related to version 2.

methods.name: addBuiltIns
methods.description: Injects service-specific built-in configuration values.

methods.name: isDirectoryBucket
methods.description: Checks if a bucket name matches directory bucket regex format.

methods.name: _applyRetryConfig
methods.description: Configures retry middleware based on provided settings.

methods.name: _applyApiProvider
methods.description: Sets up API provider and custom parsers/mutators.

methods.name: applyDocFilters
methods.description: Augments API documentation with notes and extra parameters for S3 operations.

methods.name: addDocExamples
methods.description: Adds example use cases to documentation for specific S3 commands.

methods.name: getSignatureVersionFromCommand
methods.description: Retrieves signature version info from the command context or config.
